title: leucanthemum atratum subsp. ceratophylloides
intro: Leucanthemum atratum subsp. ceratophylloides, commonly known as Mountain Daisy or White Top, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Daisy include its ability to act as a demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to calm irritated tissues, clear respiratory congestion, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
